description: List Product Hunt category options for use with get-best-products. By default returns compact top-level and nested category id, name, and slug values; pass --detailed true for descriptions, URLs, and source metadata. No Product Hunt login is required.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Return nested subcategories, descriptions, URLs, retrieval time, and full pagination metadata in addition to compact category options. Pass true or false; default false.
